basics.name: Martin Birkenbaum
basics.label: Senior Software Engineer
basics.summary: Senior Software Engineer with 8+ years of experience designing, building, and deploying scalable full-stack systems, advertiser-facing APIs, and distributed microservices. Proven track record in driving 0→1 product development, collaborating with product teams, and maintaining high engineering rigor through strong testing and developer toolchains.

work.name: Initech Corporation
work.summary: Led architecture and development of high-throughput microservices and GitOps-driven infrastructure pipelines.
highlights: Designed and implemented high-scale, Python-based event-driven microservices processing 10M+ daily events, foundational for user-facing monetization systems.
Standardized containerized deployments utilizing Docker, Kubernetes, and GitOps workflows
Mentored 6 junior/mid-level engineers, establishing local code styling and rigorous testing standards to ensure high system reliability and maintainability.
Developed custom internal toolchains that reduced CI pipeline execution times by 40%, enhancing developer productivity and operational efficiency for large-scale systems.

work.name: Hooli Inc.

Integrated third-party APIs and automated webhook processors, enabling enterprise-grade integrations for external developer and ad-tech platforms.
Implemented a comprehensive suite of unit and integration tests, raising coverage from 60% to 92% and upholding high engineering rigor.
